content: A major attack on satellites could disrupt GPS, internet services, television broadcasts, weather forecasting and air traffic control. Banking and other essential services could also suffer, potentially bringing modern life to a standstill.

title: Delhi Traders Warn Protests Could Cause Rs 10,000-Crore Loss By Diwali
content: The traders say the location is the problem. Ramlila Maidan is close to wholesale markets including Sadar Bazar, Chandni Chowk, Khari Baoli and Chawri Bazar, where the weeks leading up to Diwali are crucial for sales and deliveries.

title: Kolkata: Video shows crowd breaching barricades, tussling with cops day before stampede
content: A crowd surge at Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata led to a tragic stampede on Saturday evening. The incident occurred when heavy rain caused a rush of people seeking shelter inside the pandal. Eyewitnesses described a chaotic scene with limited crowd management and dark conditions. Following the tragedy, investigations are underway and several organisers have been detained for questioning.

title: 4 major pujas across Kolkata shut down as gloom overshadows festive mood
content: Chetla Agrani's organisers quickly acted to prevent a possible crowd surge after an earlier disaster in Chorbagan. Other popular Durga Puja spots like Tala Prattoy and College Square also halted entry as a precaution. Organisers across these venues are reassessing crowd management strategies to enhance safety and prevent similar incidents. Some pujas reduced celebratory activities in response to the nearby tragedies, demonstrating a commitment to public safety.

title: ‘Unfair’ treatment of Kuldeep Yadav? Ashwin fears another benching on NZ tour
content: Ravichandran Ashwin voices his disappointment over Kuldeep Yadav's exclusion from the Indian cricket team, arguing that a single bowler shouldn't bear the brunt of criticism when conditions are tough. He predicts that Varun Chakravarthy may be favored for the New Zealand series instead of Kuldeep. Ashwin raises concerns about India prioritizing batting strength over specialized bowlers, stressing the importance of having real wicket-takers if four seamers are in play.

title: Shark Tank’s Kevin O’Leary: Engineering is no longer the only education worth getting
content: Canadian billionaire and Shark Tank judge Kevin O’Leary has said he no longer believes engineering is the only education worth pursuing. In a post on X, O’Leary argued that storytelling, photography, video editing and content creation have become highly lucrative skills, with creators earning from contracts with multiple companies by helping brands lower customer acquisition costs and improve returns on advertising spend.

title: Man skipped ITR, declared Rs 12.9L income after notice; ITAT cancels 200% penalty
content: The man in this case failed to file his income tax return, and the Income Tax Department issued him a notice. He subsequently responded by filing an ITR for assessment year (AY) 2018-19, reporting an income of Rs 12.9 lakh. However, the Income Tax Assessing Officer (AO) took the view that this income would have remained outside the tax net had the department not issued the notice to the man.

title: Iranian fishermen hunt for iPhones and perfumes after cargo ship sinks in Hormuz
content: The Singapore-flagged GFS Pride went down after a fire broke out on board, Singapore said. All 21 crew members were evacuated safely. The vessel was carrying more than 2,500 containers when it sank, according to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) navy, which claimed the ship had entered an “unauthorised and dangerous” route and struck a sea mine, triggering the fire.

title: California farm makes 10x more leasing land for solar than wheat
content: In Tulare County, California, the Changala family farm has embraced a transformative shift from dry-farmed wheat to solar energy. Driven by financial incentives, solar leases are now yielding significantly greater income compared to traditional crops. Facing water scarcity in the San Joaquin Valley, farmers are increasingly investing in solar technologies.

title: Brad Paisley and wife help open free Nashville grocery store with $1m gift
content: Brad Paisley and Kimberly Williams-Paisley have expanded their philanthropic efforts by launching a second location of The Store, a nonprofit grocery aimed at combating food insecurity in Nashville. Following their first store's success in 2020, which garnered over 3,100 dedicated volunteers, the couple has invested $1 million into this new initiative to ensure families receive dignified access to food choices and additional resources.

title: Jack Dorsey’s $32M mansion renovation continues after 14 years; neighbors fed up
content: Since acquiring his opulent mansion in San Francisco for $9.99 million back in 2012, Jack Dorsey has been immersed in a major renovation project. The reconstruction has caused disruptions and complaints from nearby residents due to the ongoing noise. Enhancements include seismic upgrades, solar panels, and landscaped roofs. Dorsey also extended his property portfolio in 2018 with a $21.

title: British couple praises India’s healthcare after IVF in Lucknow
content: A British couple, Dave and his wife, embarked on a journey to Lucknow for IVF treatment and eagerly shared their uplifting experience. They praised the healthcare system's remarkable efficiency, especially the swift delivery of test results, which outpaced what they observed in the UK. Dave appreciated the nurturing support from the facilities and the international lounge staff during their treatment.

title: ‘Crocodiles will eat her’: How a shopping promise led to nursing officer’s murder
content: A nursing officer named Snehlata went missing after her partner, Satyaprakash, took her out under false premises. Police suspect he murdered her due to conflicts regarding their child and their relationship dynamics. Satyaprakash allegedly confessed to strangling her and disposing of her body into the Pachnada river. Her family is demanding action against him as the search for her remains continues.

title: Besieged cities, broken supply routes: Can Yemen hold its ground against Houthis
content: Yemen’s government forces face mounting difficulties as they strive to sustain their offensive against Houthi rebels. Supply routes have been severely disrupted, leading to territorial setbacks and soaring fuel costs in areas they control. The fall of key locations like the Red Sea port of Mocha only complicates matters further. Additionally, internal rifts among competing factions hinder operational efficiency, while Saudi military assistance remains vital for campaign success.

title: Kolkata stampede: SIT to probe security lapses after 19 deaths; 7 arrested
content: A tragic stampede occurred at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal, resulting in 19 fatalities and multiple injuries. The West Bengal government announced the formation of a special investigation team to look into the incident. Overcrowding and rain exacerbated the chaos, affecting visitor safety at the pandal. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari confirmed that puja committee members were detained for questioning regarding security arrangements.

title: ‘I will retire’: Medvedev threatens umpire in dramatic Shanghai loss - Watch
content: Daniil Medvedev threatened to retire from his Shanghai Masters semi-final against Rafael Jodar after officials refused to replay the Spaniard’s previous shot. The umpire eventually agreed to show it, prompting commentators to question Medvedev’s intentions. Some suspected he was buying recovery time. Despite the heated argument, Jodar defeated Medvedev 6-3, 6-4 to reach the final.

title: Yet another infra scare, 12-tonne steel cage crashes onto moving car in Mumbai
content: On Saturday afternoon, a steel reinforcement cage fell on a moving sedan on the Eastern Express Highway. Eyewitnesses reported a loud creaking noise preceding the incident, which caused structural damage to the vehicle. Fortunately, the driver and passengers escaped with minor injuries, but no serious harm was reported. The Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority imposed a penalty on the contractor and initiated an investigation after the collapse.

title: You earn, save & invest. Does that mean you're financially literate?
content: Financial literacy encompasses understanding one's income, expenses, and the risks associated with investments. Differentiating between saving and investing is crucial for effective financial planning. Individuals must be vigilant against financial fraud and misleading guidance in their investment choices. A well-structured financial plan aids in aligning savings and investments with personal objectives. Familiarity with financial concepts empowers individuals to make thoughtful decisions and manage their finances responsibly.

title: Chethan Kumar in Parallax: Made in India isn’t enough. It has to be made by India
content: India is called to transition from simply assembling products to developing and owning its technologies. This pivotal shift aims to establish a robust intellectual property framework that fosters local talent. Focusing on manufacturing alone isn't enough; innovation and unique designs must take precedence. The government is encouraged to monitor technology advancements, pushing for their commercialization.

title: Student killed, 17 injured as lighting frame collapses during dandiya event at Hyd college
content: A dandiya celebration at MVSR Engineering College led to a tragic incident on Saturday evening. A metal lighting frame collapsed during the festivities, resulting in one student's death and 17 others being injured. The Chief Minister expressed shock over the incident, directing police to take strict action against those responsible. Injured students were quickly helped and shifted to various hospitals for medical treatment.

title: Locked out, shut in, left hungry: Afghanistan after Taliban takeover
content: Since the Taliban's resurgence in Afghanistan, women's rights and access to education have suffered dramatically. Millions of girls are now prohibited from secondary and higher education, leading to dire social repercussions. In addition, food insecurity is rampant, affecting approximately 19.2 million individuals. The healthcare available has also significantly declined, obstructing women's ability to obtain necessary medical assistance. The overall humanitarian crisis continues to worsen, deeply affecting Afghan families' daily lives.

title: 12 killed after speeding truck runs over devotees near temple in Gwalior
content: A tragic accident occurred in Gwalior where a truck lost control and hit devotees waiting by a temple. Thirteen individuals lost their lives in the incident that took place in the early hours of Sunday. Nearly 40 others sustained injuries, with several reported to be in serious condition. Police and rescue teams are working to assist the injured at the scene.

title: 'India an important ally': Rubio explains why Trump paused sanctions on Russia oil buyers
content: The US government has opted to lift specific sanctions concerning the import of Russian oil and gas. This includes a review period of 60 days to evaluate the economic effects on key importers such as India and China. Senator Marco Rubio highlighted India's persistent dependency on Russian energy sources despite attempts to explore alternatives.

title: 'You have to wait': Iyer explains why Sooryavanshi missed all 5 T20Is
content: India captain Shreyas Iyer urged Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to remain patient and trust his process despite missing the entire West Indies T20I series. Iyer praised consistent openers Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma. Reflecting on India's 2-2 series draw, he blamed inconsistent bowling for missed opportunities and praised West Indies captain Shai Hope, who won Player of the Series.

title: Major fire at Canadian military base in Alberta, Carney calls it ‘serious incident’
content: A major fire erupted at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta on Saturday, prompting concern among officials. Prime Minister Mark Carney deemed the situation serious, highlighting the safety of impacted personnel. Alberta Premier Danielle Smith labeled the blaze significant, emphasizing its repercussions for military staff. While the cause and damage details remain undisclosed, the federal government is actively collaborating with local agencies to manage the crisis.

title: 'There is pressure on us': Pakistan's ICC trophy drought adds to players' burden
content: Pakistan last reached the final of an ICC tournament at the 2022 T20 World Cup in Australia, where they lost to England in Melbourne.

title: Chris Woakes autobiography: Former England seamer slams Rob Key over 'shabby' exit
content: Woakes, who played 217 international matches for England across formats, including 62 Tests, made his final red-ball appearance during the fifth Test against India at The Oval in August 2025. Despite dislocating his shoulder while fielding, he came out to bat in a bid to help his team.

title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' box office collection day 16: Film crosses Rs 500cr
content: Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' saw a 61.3% increase in box office collections on its third Saturday. The movie earned Rs 5 crore on Day 16, improving its cumulative domestic net collection to Rs 341.10 crore. Its worldwide gross collection reached Rs 528.77 crore, with domestic and overseas contributions. The film, which continues the story from its predecessor, features an ensemble cast including Tabu and Shriya Saran.

title: 'Jailer 2' BO day 3: Rajinikanth, Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar film crosses Rs 300 cr worldwide
content: 'Jailer 2', starring the iconic Rajinikanth, saw a remarkable increase in its box office performance on day three, grossing Rs 47.80 crore in India, a leap of 28.8% from the prior day. This brought the total net collection in India to an impressive Rs 144.60 crore. Overall, the worldwide collection reached Rs 317.15 crore, showcasing its extraordinary appeal.

title: Kolkata stampede: 12 detained, including pandal organisers; 19 dead
content: A tragic stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata has claimed the lives of at least 17 people. The chaos was reportedly caused by severe rain and a massive influx of attendees. Eyewitnesses recounted scenes of distress, with numerous individuals fainting under the circumstances. Emergency services acted quickly, transporting the seriously injured to Calcutta Medical College.

title: Indians to benefit as Canada moves to award points for job offers, high-wage occupations
content: Canada has reintroduced Express Entry points for qualifying job offers in high-wage occupations and will also award additional points for eligible Canadian work experience in these occupations . eligible candidates can receive up to 70 additional points (under the comprehensive ranking system – CRS) on top of their standard experience score, this could give them up to 150 points .

title: 19 killed in Kolkata stampede; CM Suvendu announces jobs, Rs 25 lakh for kin
content: a fact-finding committee will be constituted to investigate the incident . the state government will also bear the entire cost of medical treatment for the injured . 19 people have lost their lives, 17 of whom died on the spot, the chief minister says .

title: SC: No need for nod to prosecute govt official seeking bribe
content: the court stressed that the shield of prior sanction from higher authorities to prosecute a public servant is not available if they are caught demanding bribes . the ruling was given by a bench of justices SVN Bhatti and N V Anjaria while interpreting Section 17A of the Act .

title: Kolkata stampede: Sharp spell turns Chorbagan puja pandal into death trap
content: a sudden and unexpectedly sharp spell of shower turned into a torrential downpour . sporadic rain had been predicted by the Met office till Saturday . it was expected to be restricted to drizzles . the evening spell turned out to be consistent and lasted nearly an hour .

title: France protests turn violent: Fires, looting and 1,200 arrests; Macron vows action

title: Watch: Historic French town hall burnt, tear gas fired as 5,50,00 protest in France
content: demonstrations turn violent in several cities across france, belgium, italy and portugal . demonstrations over rising living costs, low wages and deteriorating public services turn violent . riot police used tear gas and baton charges to disperse crowds .

title: 'Kicked me for 10 mins': Trump 'disturbed' by West Bank attack on US photojournalist
content: president Donald Trump 'disturbed' as american photojournalist undergoes surgery . the attack by settlers in the west bank has drawn widespread condemnation . american secretary of state Marco Rubio says he does not want friction or crisis going on .

title: ‘I found my wife lying still’: Husband’s heartbreaking account of Kolkata stampede
content: the crowd management there was decent, and people were being regulated properly . my wife wanted to visit the pandal because she had seen its interiors in several reels . when we reached Chorbagan, the place was packed . the crowd had spilled over to Central Avenue .

title: Watch: French protesters loot Hermès, Apple and other luxury stores
content: protesters vandalised luxury boutiques, electronics outlets, supermarkets and other businesses across several french cities . authorities reported mass arrests, injured police officers and fires . in Marseille, looters smashed the window of a skincare store near République Square .

title: Israeli settlers attack European diplomats; Netanyahu says no ‘compelling evidence'
content: settlers attacked european diplomats, palestinian olive harvesters and a visiting french mayor in the occupied west bank . footage shows one diplomatic vehicle being pelted with stones, with a window smashed . masked settlers demanded identification documents before attacking it .

title: Behind the lights and grandeur: What it takes and costs to build a Durga Pujo pandal
content: a pujo is a few days of colour, light and sound before the dhak . it runs on money raised from the neighbourhood, a small circle of skilled craftsmen and a large number of people who all have to be in the right place on the right day . a medium-scale pujo costs several lakh rupees .

title: Prices of 137 cancer drugs to fall by up to 70% from November 9
content: this follows a nudge by Supreme Court, flagging the huge gap between price to retailer and MRP of medicines billed to patients . the 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs are set to be reduced by up to 70% from Nov 9 with govt capping trade margins by 30% .
